name: strike
title: Strike
description: A red pencil through real words: one line, two lines, or a cross-out. The text stays readable and real underneath, so a price that was 49 can still be copied and read by a screen reader.

files.content:
"use client"

import * as React from "react"
import { Slot } from "radix-ui"

import { MARK_WIPE, useMarkInk } from "@/hooks/use-mark-ink"
import { useMergedRef } from "@/lib/ink/react"
import { strikeRecipe, type StrikeKind } from "@/lib/ink/recipes/strike-ink"
import type { MarkPen, MarkWeight } from "@/lib/ink/recipes/text-marks-ink"
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

const FALLBACK: Record<MarkPen, string> = {
  ink: "decoration-ink",
  blue: "decoration-ink-you",
  red: "decoration-red",
  green: "decoration-green",
  pencil: "decoration-pencil-mark",
  marker: "decoration-marker",
  orange: "decoration-tangerine",
}

function Strike({
  kind = "single",
  tone = "red",
  weight = "regular",
  animate = false,
  show = true,
  delay,
  seed,
  asChild = false,
  className,
  children,
  ref,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<"s"> & {
  kind?: StrikeKind
  tone?: MarkPen
  weight?: MarkWeight
  animate?: boolean
  show?: boolean
  delay?: number
  seed?: string | number
  asChild?: boolean
}) {
  const { hostRef, hostProps, nodes } = useMarkInk({
    recipe: strikeRecipe,
    params: { kind, tone, weight },
    kind: "strike",
    seed,
    mode: kind === "cross" ? "box" : "lines",
    over: true,
    animate,
    show,
    delay,
  })
  const Comp = asChild ? Slot.Root : "s"
  return (
    <Comp
      data-slot="strike"
      data-kind={kind}
      ref={useMergedRef<HTMLElement>(hostRef, ref as React.Ref<HTMLElement> | undefined)}
      {...hostProps}
      className={cn(
        "relative isolate decoration-1 data-[ink-ready]:no-underline data-[mark=off]:no-underline forced-colors:not-data-[mark=off]:line-through! not-focus-visible:outline-none forced-colors:not-focus-visible:outline-none!",
        FALLBACK[tone],
        animate && "no-underline noscript:line-through",
        animate && MARK_WIPE,
        className,
      )}
      {...props}
    >
      <Slot.Slottable>{children}</Slot.Slottable>
      {nodes}
    </Comp>
  )
}

export { Strike }

a11y: A real <s> element, which browsers and many screen readers treat as content that is no longer accurate. Say what changed in the surrounding text ("was", "now") rather than relying on the line alone.

When the line is only decoration (a ticked-off task whose state a checkbox already announces) use `asChild` on a <span>, so the words are not marked as deleted for everyone, and `show` for the on and off states; with `show={false}` the native line-through is hidden too.
The text underneath stays selectable and copyable; the drawing is aria-hidden and pointer-events-none.
Before the drawing exists and in Windows high contrast the browser's own line-through is shown.
